name: How long does it take to install exterior lighting?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install exterior lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior lighting installation project depends on its scope and complexity. A small project, such as adding a few security lights or path lights, might take one to two days. More extensive landscape lighting systems, involving multiple zones, complex wiring, or specialized fixtures, could take several days to a week or more. We'll provide a clear timeline estimate after evaluating your specific project during the initial consultation. Factors like weather conditions can also influence the schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from one to two days for small projects to a week or more for extensive systems. We provide a timeline estimate after an on-site evaluation.
